title: SWF: play-once/loop graphic symbol instances ignore firstFrame — no seek emitted
description: When a graphic symbol instance has loopMode='play-once' or loopMode='loop' and firstFrame > 0, compile.ts never seeks to that starting frame. The play-once path only emits a stop() clip action; the loop path emits nothing. Both modes should also emit a gotoAndPlay(firstFrame+1) (or gotoAndStop for play-once) on the instance so playback begins at the declared starting frame. The model field firstFrame is documented as 'Starting frame index for single-frame or play-once mode' but is only consumed in the single-frame branch (line 1977). Fix: in the isFirst branch for loopMode='play-once' and loopMode='loop', when firstFrame > 0, additionally emit an onClipEvent(load){ gotoAndPlay(firstFrame+1); } clip action alongside the existing stop()/nothing. Location: packages/swf/src/compile.ts:1950-1966.
